title: Make & Model
description: Want to be able to load the make & model also on the homescreen when loading the vehicle registration and vin. At this stage i must go and edit to be able to load it

rounds.aiContent: On the homescreen, where staff enter a vehicle's registration and VIN, also let them fill in the make and model right there — instead of having to save first and then open Edit just to add it. This just brings that field forward onto the intake screen; nothing about how make/model is stored or shown elsewhere changes.

questions.prompt: Is this the right idea: add a make & model field to the homescreen, next to registration and VIN, so you don't have to edit the vehicle afterward just to set it?

options.label: Close, but not quite -- see my comment
